profile.summary: K.P. Energy Limited provides balance of plant solutions for renewable energy sector in India. It operates through Infrastructure Development, Sale of Power, and Operation & Maintenance Services segments. The company offers solutions for wind power and wind-solar hybrid power project development, which comprises site identification, meticulous site preparation, efficient construction and erection,
